description: This file defines the Customer class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Customer namespace, providing methods for managing customer data including creation, updating, deletion, retrieval, and filtering operations within an OpenCart-based administration system.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents the customer model with methods to perform CRUD operations and to retrieve customer data based on various filters.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents the customer model with methods to perform CRUD operations and retrieve customer data based on various filters.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Inserts a new customer record into the database and returns the new customer ID.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates the data of an existing customer identified by customer ID.

methods.name: editToken
methods.description: Updates the token value for a specified customer.

methods.name: editCommenter
methods.description: Sets the commenter status for a specified customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Removes a customer and associated related data from the database.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific customer by ID.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches customer details matching a provided email address.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers filtered and sorted based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Counts the total number of customers matching certain filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Counts customers belonging to a specified customer group.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes activity records associated with a specific customer ID.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address for a customer, setting it as default if specified, and returns the address ID.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address for a customer.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes one or all addresses associated with a customer, optionally by address ID.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific address by address ID.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses associated with a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a specific country ID.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByZoneId
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a specific zone ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history comment for a customer.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records for a customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves paginated history comments for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a customer.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Deletes wishlist entries for a customer.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Deletes all transaction records for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transaction records associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves paginated transaction records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Counts the total addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByCountryId
methods.description: Counts the addresses for a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByZoneId
methods.description: Counts the addresses for a specific zone.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts the total histories for a customer.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves paginated transaction records for a customer based on start and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total number of transactions for a specific customer ID.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the sum total of all transactions for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts the total number of transaction records associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Inserts a reward record for a customer, with optional description, points, and order ID.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes all reward records for a specific customer.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward records associated with a specific order ID where points > 0.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the count of reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of reward points for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts reward records associated with a specific order ID where points > 0.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Removes all IP address records for a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of IP address records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts the total number of IP address records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByIp
methods.description: Counts the number of customers associated with a specific IP address.

methods.name: getTotalLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt data for a given email address.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Removes login attempt records for a given email.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates an authorization record for a customer with token, IP, user agent, and timestamp.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (e.g., active/inactive) of a specific authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total value associated with a customer authorization.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets all authorization totals for a specific customer to zero.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a customer, optionally by specific authorization ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Fetches authorization details based on customer ID and a specific token.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Retrieves authorization records for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts total authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalLoginAttempts
methods.description: Counts total login attempts for a specific email.
